name: YYLO
description: Orchestrate coding agents from the terminal with typed tasks, skills installs, and receipt-backed merge gates; Pi is a supported subagent.
compatibility: Optional Pi coding-agent integration: yy pi runs one-shot or live sessions (ypl) with model shortcuts such as anthropic/claude and openai-codex provider models.
Installs reusable agent skills via npx skills add into .pi/skills and .claude/skills; yy ledger and yy benchmark delegate to separately installed sibling CLIs.
limitations: Requires Node.js 20.10 or newer and Git; upstream does not document per-operating-system support.

The orchestrator itself contacts no model provider: subagents such as Pi are installed and configured separately, and provider credentials, model availability, and any local model servers remain external.
Evidence describes unreleased CLI 0.2.12; features and required companion versions may differ from the published stable package.

Advanced-mode bootstrap can create an initial commit and protected integration-owner worktree in an empty Git repository. Simple mode uses a shared checkout; fresh Simple initialization downloads agent skills by default unless --no-skills is set. Review skills before loading them.

sources.note: Upstream project definition, prerequisites, Pi subagent integration and model shortcuts, skills installation paths, and bootstrap behavior.
Declares the @yylo/cli npm package, MIT license, Node.js >=20.10.0 engine, and command binaries.
